title: Predicting olanzapine induced BMI increase using machine learning on population-based electronic health records.
summary: 11,984 Danish adults in psychiatric EHRs were used to predict >5% BMI increase during olanzapine exposure. The article reports risk models as preliminary and calls for prospective/external validation.
